newsitem.title: UK: BFI continues fall as grain fixtures weaken.
newsitem.headline: BFI continues fall as grain fixtures weaken.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was down nine on Thursday to 1,361 points which brokers said was against a background of a continued fall in most areas.

Weaker grain fixtures were seen with Bunget taking Captain Veniamis for about 90,000 light grains Mississippi to Holland for Feb 7/12 at $950,000 lumpsum and Cobelfret taking Lemnos 55,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Ghent for Feb 18/25 at $11.50.
Grain rates were also weaker in the Pacific, 52,500 heavy grain NoPac to South Korea fixed at $11.50 by Pan Ocean and 50,000 barley NoPac to Saudi Arabia by Dreyfus at $19.75 both for Mid Feb.
The Baltic Handy Index was down 11 at 1,016 points.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was between 24 and five points down and turnover was 159 lots.
